name: kimi-vs-gpt-auditor
description: Independent text and rendered artifact visual review, including PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, SVG and images.

interface.shortDescription: Text and rendered artifact visual review
interface.longDescription: Automatically adds one compact independent pre-answer review for complex analysis, research, troubleshooting, planning, recommendations, comparisons, and architecture decisions. When a material conclusion depends on fresh public facts, the host may perform one narrow web verification pass and send only compressed source evidence into the review packet. Standard review is used for ordinary complex work; deep Kimi review is reserved for high-stakes, unusually disputed, weak-evidence, or explicitly rigorous tasks. The external critic does not browse autonomously, draft the final answer, perform open-ended primary research, or generate complete code. For visual artifacts, use review_visual_page with a real rendered page image; never substitute a textual description for visual evidence.
defaultPrompt: Before finalizing this complex answer, challenge the leading conclusion and identify any missing evidence.
Review this troubleshooting direction for anchoring and overlooked alternatives before giving the final steps.
Check this recommendation for unsupported assumptions, constraint violations, and overconfidence before committing to it.
Render every page of the final artifact and use review_visual_page to verify actual visual quality before delivery.
